name: Geoenvironmental and Geotechnical Engineering Lab
description: Engineering properties and compaction characteristics of waste materials such as coal ash and mine tailings. Permeability testing of clays and bentonite-amended soils. Physical, mechanical, and hydraulic testing of geosynthetics. Landfill liner and cover: evaluation of shear strength parameters of various interfaces and design considerations. Project-based evaluation of engineering properties of soils for embankment design. Demonstration of direct push technology for geoenvironmental subsurface sampling and characterization.
